items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 175kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 175 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information: ### Outside Food not permitted### This venue does **not** allow anyone to bring outside food or drinks in. Bringing in water is allowed. The venue's concession will be open. We apologize for the inconvenience and we thank you for your cooperation. **Registration Reminders** You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. **Unpaid registrations will not be accepted**. ​ Since this is a "favourites" competition, you may choose **at most five (5) events**. ​ Please review all of the tabs listed on this website. Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ​ Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before September 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST. ​ **First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules. ​ **Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of competitions consent to their images being used by SpeedCubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNzU0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c8c5e71fb067c6e8e5103b433be893d948fe1be6/CaminosGuanajuato.jpg) **ESPAÑOL** 🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶 ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Guanajuato, Guanajuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** finaliza su recorrido y en **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Esta competencia forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de *José Alfredo Jiménez* acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Guanajuato. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Guanajuato para culminar juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **ENGLISH** 🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶 The **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** route ends its journey in **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, a city that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and everyday life come together in every corner. This competition is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing, but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different host cities through a shared spirit of competition and celebration. At each stop along the way, the music of *José Alfredo Jiménez* symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have become an essential expression of the spirit and emotions of the people of Guanajuato, inspire this edition dedicated to Guanajuato. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Guanajuato to finalize the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--972806504f8e67211ebc816281b9ddf1b8bf11e5/MOLOLOA.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 29 y domingo 30 de agosto de 2026. El Mololoa Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, Aug 29, and Sunday, Aug 30, 2026. Mololoa Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a8ab6aa393063e4885b78fe22730fbdb06d76ab9/Kewbz%20UKC26%20LOGO.jpg) ## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4NDUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6547f5d596befc73699700f8fea7d96dde8f8efb/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: **BAHASA INDONESIA:** Kalibata Agustusan 2026 merupakan kompetisi speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Plaza Kalibata, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan dilaksanakan selama 2 hari dan terbuka untuk umum. **Khusus cabang Fewest Moves Challenge (FMC), kuota peserta dibatasi hanya untuk 15 kompetitor pertama (siapa cepat, dia dapat).** Kami tidak akan menerima pendaftaran Anda jika Anda belum mengisi link [formulir konfirmasi](https://forms.gle/zPdm3HT5cHYHPnt78). Untuk informasi selengkapnya, pastikan Anda melihat ketentuan pendaftaran pada tab [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalibataAgustusan2026/register) atau hubungi [kontak (Ejane - 085219391525)](https://wa.me/6285219391525) yang disediakan. ______ **ENGLISH:** Kalibata Agustusan 2026 is a speedcubing competition that will be held at Plaza Kalibata, Jakarta. It will be held in 2 days and is open to public. **For Fewest Moves Challenge (FMC) event is limited to the first 15 competitors only (first come, first served).** We will not accept your registration if you haven't paid and fill the [confirmation form](https://forms.gle/zPdm3HT5cHYHPnt78). For further infomation, please check on the Registration Requirement on [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalibataAgustusan2026/register) tab or [contact (Ejane - 085219391525](https://wa.me/6285219391525) the contact provided.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyODYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1e4894d78da01f540cf034021bf4d9bf981e69c8/nm2026.jpeg) ## 🇳🇴 (NB) Informasjon Velkommen til norgesmesterskapet i kubing 2026, denne gangen tilbake i Trondheim. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er hjertelig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇳🇴 (NN) Informasjon Velkomen til noregsmeisterskapen i kubing, som er tilbake i Trondheim i år. Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegongsdeltakarar Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information. For information regarding FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD, please refer to the [FMC/BLIND](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#67514-fmc-blind) tab. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#62666-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips. --- To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) and follow CubingBC on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/p/Cubingbc-61569731858139/) or [Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/cubingbc/) Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png) **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NzE4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2b53712ac871ab6dd62d8e0a7492a029417cfaa/logo-cec-1.jpg) **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję Silesian Minx Fest - wyjątkowych zawodów z minxami na wolnym powietrzu! Wydarzenie jest organizowane dzięki wsparciu Wojewódzkiej Biblioteki Publicznej im. Emanuela Smołki w Opolu! Zapoznaj się ze wszystkimi zakładkami przed rejestracją. Zwróć szczególną uwagę, że konkurencje poniedziałkowe i wtorkowe, czyli 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia, 3x3x3 najmniejsza liczba ruchów oraz 4x4x4 bez patrzenia i 5x5x5 bez patrzenia odbędą się w innym obiekcie oddalonym od głównej sali (namiotu) o około 500m. Adres to ul. Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole. --------- ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We invite you to the fourth edition of Silesian Minx Fest - the unusual outdoor competition with minxes as the main theme! The competition is organized thanks to the support of the Voivodeship Public Library in Opole! Please check information in all tabs before registrating. Please note that Monday's and Tuesday's events: FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD and MBLD will take place in another venue about 500 m away from the main venue. The address: Krakowska 39, 45-075 Opole. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNTkzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9b9765836db845605e3f7adc48700700f9c0a0ca/logo%20wca%20poziom%20(1).png)

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: Please note that this competition takes place on a **Tuesday evening**. Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest in order to maintain safety and manage the pace of the competition. We strongly encourage competitors to avoid bringing a guest if possible. All competitors **MUST** arrive by 6:30pm and stay until the end of the competition, regardless of which group they are assigned to compete in. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgzNzQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--85d7f1c565dad12a0a3f3ad8a2e9946cf4745708/Anuncio_cuadrado.png) **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** Durante el evento se realizarán fotografías y grabaciones de video que podrán ser utilizadas por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión institucional. Al participar, aceptas el uso de tu imagen conforme a lo establecido en nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**! **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photographs and video recordings will take place during the event and may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotional, documentation, and outreach purposes. By attending, you consent to the use of your image in accordance with our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: Bem-vindos ao Aníbal ao Cubo 2026! A Escola Aníbal Cesar começou a história do Cubo Mágico na cidade de itajaí, e com satisfação recebe o seu 3º campeonato oficial! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para novatos na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) ATENÇÃO! Informamos que o cronograma pode ser adiantado ao longo do dia, por isso esteja no local para competir pelo menos 30 minutos antes da sua modalidade começar. ⚠️ Inscrições no local serão aceitas exclusivamente para a modalidade 3x3x3. 🇺🇸 Welcome to Aníbal ao Cubo 2026! Aníbal Cesar School started the Rubik’s Cube scene in the city of Itajaí and is pleased to host its 3rd official competition! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance — more information in the “Register” tab. If you have difficulties registering, see how to do it in this video: https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.) ATTENTION! Please note that the schedule may be brought forward throughout the day, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. ⚠️ On-site registration will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

items.information: # Português • A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. • Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. • **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. • **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. • As inscrições custam R$ 25,00 (vinte e cinco reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). • Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 30,00 (trinta reais), caso haja vagas. • # English • Registration is open to any person, from any country. • To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. • **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. • **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. • Registration costs R$25.00 (twenty five Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). • On-site registrations will be accepted for R$30,00 (Thirty Brazilian reais), if there are still places.

items.information: **Special Notice** [**FMC World 2026 - Guangzhou**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026) will be held on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 8:00 to 12:00 in the Meeting Room of Conghua Argyle Hotel (No. 514 Guangcong South Road), Guangzhou. This event is a simultaneous FMC competition for fewest moves enthusiasts worldwide. In addition to the official global top three awards, the Guangzhou Site will present separate awards to its top three competitors. June 21, 2026 coincides with the summer solstice; at noon, the sun will directly shine on the Tropic of Cancer (23°26′N). After the morning fewest moves competition finishes, we cordially invite all competitors to gather at the nearby Guangzhou Tropic of Cancer Park. An award ceremony will be held in front of the Tropic of Cancer Memorial Tower, where competitors will jointly stack a tower column with Rubik's Cubes, witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of "an upright pole casting no shadow." Event page: https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026 Registration process: First, complete registration via the event page above (WCA account login required). Then, pay the registration fee using Alipay to the Guangzhou Cubing account (gzcubeteam@gmail.com). Upon successful payment, registration will be confirmed. For any questions regarding registration or payment, please contact the organizer via email (same address as above), or search for the WeChat public account "动物魔友会Animal Cubing" and reach out to customer service within the public account. **About the Competition** Organization Team: Aite Canton Cultural Planning Service Co., Ltd. GZ Cube Team **About the Awards** 1) This competition only has the big cube puzzles speed-solving event. In addition to the awards for the top three in each event, awards will also be given to the first place in the competition in the sum of rankings of all events. If there is a tie in the total ranking, the better ranking of 4x4x4 Cube will be given priority based on most registration. 2) Competitors must accept any certificates, awards, or prizes in person. Competitors that do not appear in person will forfeit any prizes. 3) The main event of this event is the 4x4x4 Cube, and the first place in this event will be announced as the champion of this competition. **Accompanying Persons and Spectators** To ensure a quiet and orderly competition environment, each competitor may bring a maximum of 1 accompanying person for free admission. Any additional accompanying persons must purchase an admission ticket on-site at the price of ¥50 per person per day. All accompanying persons must register together with the contestant. **Friendly Reminder** This competition does not have any official competitor chat groups. Please be mindful of protecting your personal information and property. If you have any questions, please email the organizers at gzcubeteam@gmail.com, or search for our official account "动物魔友会" (Animal Cubing) on WeChat and contact customer service through the account.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2026! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF for dere som gir oss beskjed om det. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members who inform us about their membership. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!** Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MDQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7286e497558051c0ce9375dec80a8b4c666da8b1/sesi-logo-3.png) # REGISTRO ### ATENÇÃO: Faça o registro no site MeuSESI para ter acesso às dependências do SESI. Você pode se cadastrar [clicando aqui](https://meusesi.sesisp.org.br/Reserva/0ee4eb94-ec6f-4490-b47e-08dea9de73cd) **A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:** * Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; * Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; * Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$15,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com** * Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.** * Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org). OBS.: Alunos e Associados do SESI estão isentos da taxa de insrição, mas devem Informar que são alunos do SESI no campo INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS durante o ato da inscrição. # REGISTRATION ### ATTENTION: Register on the MeuSESI website to access SESI facilities. You can register by [clicking here](https://meusesi.sesisp.org.br/Reserva/0ee4eb94-ec6f-4490-b47e-08dea9de73cd) **The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:** * Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; * Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. * Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$15,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com** * Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.** * For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org). OBS.: SESI students and associates are exempt from the registration fee, but they must inform that they are SESI students in the ADDITIONAL INFORMATION field during registration.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [**Cubing Contests**](https://cubingcontests.com). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the third edition of Örebro Side Events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This competition will also include Unofficial Events, rules and results can be found at **[Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com)**. Read more under the tab Unofficial Events. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** **Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** **Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: **Português** **Inscrição Gratuita.** Por favor, pedimos que só se inscreva se tiver certeza que poderá participar da competição. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** **Free Registration.** Please only register if you are certain that you will be able to participate in the competition. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcwODMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8353064ff996ef2d056815725f11f1ef2a0e7863/image.png) Το Halkida Spring Open 2026 θα είναι ο επόμενος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2026 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στην πανέμορφη πόλη της Χαλκίδας! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Halkida Spring Open 2026 will be our next official competition of 2026 and the first ever to be held in the beautiful city of Halkida! In the welcoming conference hall of the Lucy Hotel, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

This competition serves as the sequel to **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and will feature **Clock** as the main event. Additional official events include **3×3, Megaminx, Skewb, 3x3 One-Handed (OH), 3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC), and 5×5 Blindfolded (5BLD)**. The competition will also include the unofficial event **3×3 Team Blindfolded**. Participation in unofficial events is entirely optional and will not affect official competition results. Additional unofficial events, including **1×3×3 Floppy Cube** and **Magic**, are **tentative** and may be added depending on schedule availability and logistical considerations. Please refer to the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026#72726-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for further details. All competitors and guests are encouraged to carefully review the information tabs on this page for details regarding the **competition schedule, event regulations, venue guidelines, and registration procedures**. Familiarizing yourself with this information will help ensure the competition runs smoothly and that all participants have an enjoyable experience. We look forward to seeing you at **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: **Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must fill out this [form](https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A) and be accompanied by an adult parent/guardian at all times. Join us for a short competition on the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026)! items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PampulhaOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$25. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PampulhaOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$25. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** Sejam todos bem-vindos à mais uma competição Capivara em parceria com o Colégio SEB Dom Bosco! Esta é uma edição muito especial, em homenagem ao Mês da Mulher. Para celebrar essa data tão importante, teremos pódios femininos em todas as modalidades, incluindo a categoria iniciante. Chamem suas amigas e venham comemorar conosco esse momento de reconhecimento e valorização! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". This is a very special edition, held in honor of Women’s Month. To celebrate this important occasion, we will have female podiums in all event categories, including the beginner category. Invite your friends and come celebrate this meaningful and empowering moment with us! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. items.information: Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады. Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет. АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін. Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады. Жарыс Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары холлда өтеді. Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды. Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз English: The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia. Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery. The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device. The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment. The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall. Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life. We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8efbb86064c7715684b16e2c61c3057e7be46ee5/IMG_3706.jpeg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d377905ca8a83b9f95df9338d24320f682f5446/IMG_3705.jpeg) 🇧🇷 **(Português) Brasileiro:** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). ❗️❗️**IMPORTANT** This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page. If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.
